title: Positive Acceptance Probability Implies RSPACE
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $L$ be a language of bit strings, let $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $c\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ with $0<\delta$. Suppose that on every input $x$, some time bound $T$ ensures halting on every branch; on members, the probability of outputting $[1]$ within that bound is at least $\delta$; and on nonmembers, every choice string of length $T$ yields output $[0]$. Suppose also that the space used on every input and choice string is at most $c s(|x|)$. Then $L$ belongs to $\mathrm{RSPACE}(s)$, the class with a constant-multiple space bound, halting on every branch within an input-dependent finite time, acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members, and certain rejection on nonmembers.
